summary: PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; CLI requires repository root, plan dir, canonical output receipt path, maintainer refresh flag, and in-plan skill-input receipt; validates implementation contract and plan/state identifiers; accepts only plan-ready or explicitly refreshed implementation-authorized state; refresh archives predecessor exclusively under repair/round-1 with hash-derived name; binds contract, registries, manifests, context, validation/closure/delta/candidate receipts, validators, skill input/request, immutable predecessor with SHA-256; computes candidate binding hash; updates plan-state and resume-state to implementation-authorized/run-slice; writes authorization receipt and appends completion report; authorizes implementation-authorized only, excluding completion, acceptance, publication, bootstrap, release; apparent malformed predecessor_authorization receipt entry may cause Python syntax failure and is an unresolved ambiguity.
